title: The completion of a Noetherian local ring is faithfully flat
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local ring and $R^\wedge=\varprojlim_nR/\mathfrak m^n$ its $\mathfrak m$-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Then the canonical map $R\to R^\wedge$ is faithfully flat: it is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] and the induced map $\operatorname{Spec}R^\wedge\to\operatorname{Spec}R$, $\mathfrak q\mapsto\mathfrak q\cap R$, is surjective (for a flat ring map these two conditions are equivalent to faithful flatness, Algebra Lemma 00HP).

source.place: Lemma Tag 00MC (lemma-completion-faithfully-flat, line 22977), 'In particular' clause (I = m is in the Jacobson radical of the local ring R); proof via Lemma 00MB and Lemma 00HP (lemma-ff)
